dg:chunk.docset:PropertyPortfolioLabel: Property 1: Elysium Dome, Sector Alpha (Office & Laboratory Facility)
dg:chunk.dg:chunk: LANDLORD: Ares Prime Yield Fund I, LP, a Martian limited partnership
TENANT: Ares Terraform Corp, a Martian corporation

docset:LeaseAgreementType.docset:Recital: THIS COMMERCIAL PRESSURIZED SPACE LEASE AGREEMENT (this "Lease") is entered into and made effective as of October 12, 2082 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Ares Prime Yield Fund I, LP, a Martian limited partnership registered with the Ares Municipal Commerce Board under Registry No. MP-99402-L (hereinafter referred to as "Landlord"), and Ares Terraform Corp, a Martian corporation registered under Registry No. MC-11048-C (hereinafter referred to as "Tenant").

dg:chunk.docset:PremisesDescription: • 1.1. Premises: Sector A-4, Dome 1 (Elysium), Ares Prime, consisting of approximately 12,500 square meters of pressurized, radiation-shielded Class-A Office and Laboratory space (the "Premises"), as more particularly delineated on the floor plan attached hereto as Exhibit A.
dg:chunk.dg:chunk: • 1.2. Term: Fifteen (15) Martian Years, commencing on October 12, 2082 (the "Commencement Date"), and expiring on October 11, 2097 (the "Expiration Date"), unless sooner terminated or extended pursuant to the terms hereof.

• 1.3. Base Rent: Initial Base Rent shall be Five Million Six Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Martian Credits (M$ 5,625,000.00) per annum (representing M$ 450.00 per pressurized square meter), payable in equal monthly installments of Four Hundred Sixty-Eight Thousand Seven Hundred Fifty Martian Credits (M$ 468,750.00) in advance on the first day of each Martian calendar month.
dg:chunk.docset:UtilityAndOperatingExpenseRespons: • 1.4. Atmospheric Common Area Maintenance (ACAM) / Life Support Systems (LSS) Operating Expenses: Tenant's Proportionate Share is 100% of the single-tenant building, and 12.5% of the Dome 1 regional life support grid.
dg:chunk.docset:PersonalGuaranty: • 1.5. Security Deposit: One Million Martian Credits (M$ 1,000,000.00) held in the Offworld Escrow Bank of Phobos.
• 1.6. Guarantor: Terran Terraform Holdings LLC, a Delaware (Earth) limited liability company.

docset:BaseRent.docset:RentEscalationFormula: 2.1. Escalation Schedule: On each anniversary of the Commencement Date (each, an "Adjustment Date"), the Base Rent shall be adjusted to equal the greater of:

dg:chunk.docset:RentEscalationRate: (a) The Base Rent in effect immediately prior to the Adjustment Date multiplied by 1.035 (representing a 3.5% annual compound escalation); or
dg:chunk.dg:chunk: (b) The Base Rent in effect immediately prior to the Adjustment Date adjusted by the percentage increase, if any, in the Martian Consumer Price Index (MCPI) as published by the Ares Municipal Commerce Board for the preceding twelve (12) Martian month period.

• 3.1. Tenant Improvement Allowance: Landlord shall provide Tenant with a one-time Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance of One Million Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Martian Credits (M$ 1,250,000.00) (M$ 100.00 per sq.m.) to be applied solely toward the construction of specialized atmospheric scrubbers, secondary internal radiation baffling, and Class-10 cleanroom airlocks (the "Tenant Work"). Tenant shall be responsible for all costs of the Tenant Work in excess of the TI Allowance.
dg:chunk.docset:RentConcession: • 3.2. Free Rent Period: Tenant shall receive a full abatement of Base Rent for the first six (6) consecutive Martian months of the Term (the "Abatement Period"). During the Abatement Period, Tenant shall remain fully liable for its share of ACAM/LSS Operating Expenses and all other Additional Rent.

docset:LifeSupportAndAtmosphericSystemsO.dg:chunk: ARTICLE 4: LIFE SUPPORT SYSTEMS AND OPERATING EXPENSES

dg:chunk.docset:ExpenseStructure: • 4.1. Net Lease: This is a Triple-Net (NNN) Lease. Landlord shall not be responsible for any expenses, taxes, utilities, or maintenance costs associated with the Premises, except as expressly set forth herein.
dg:chunk.docset:LifeSupportAndAtmosphericSystemsO: • 4.2. Recovery of ACAM/LSS Expenses: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as Additional Rent its Proportionate Share of all expenses incurred by Landlord in the operation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of the Dome 1 Life Support Systems and Common Areas, including but not limited to: nitrogen/oxygen atmospheric replenishment, carbon dioxide scrubbing, relative humidity maintenance, micrometeorite deflection shield operations, and primary dome structural monitoring (collectively, "ACAM/LSS Expenses").
dg:chunk.docset:UtilityAndOperatingExpenseRespons: • 4.3. Exclusions: ACAM/LSS Expenses shall specifically exclude: (a) capital costs for the initial construction or structural replacement of the primary Dome 1 outer structural membrane; (b) costs resulting from Landlord's negligence or willful misconduct; and (c) any offworld corporate overhead expenses of Landlord.

dg:chunk.dg:RenewalOption: • 5.1. Renewal Option: Tenant shall have two (2) consecutive options to extend the Term of this Lease for a period of five (5) Martian Years each (each, an "Extension Term"). To exercise each option, Tenant must deliver written notice to Landlord no later than twelve (12) Martian months prior to the expiration of the then-current Term. The Base Rent for each Extension Term shall be ninety-five percent (95%) of the then-current Fair Market Martian Rent (FMMR) for comparable space in Elysium Dome, but in no event less than the Base Rent payable in the final month of the preceding Term.
dg:chunk.dg:ExpansionOption: • 5.2. Expansion Option: Tenant shall have a Right of First Offer (ROFO) to lease any available sub-surface storage vault space in Sector A-5 adjacent to the Premises. If Landlord intends to market Sector A-5, Landlord shall first offer such space to Tenant at current market rates.

dg:HazardousMaterialsCovenant.dg:chunk: ARTICLE 6: REGOLITH CONTAMINATION AND HAZARDOUS MATERIALS

dg:chunk.dg:HazardousMaterialsCovenant: • 6.1. Regolith Mitigation: Tenant acknowledges that fine-particulate Martian regolith poses severe risks to mechanical seals, electrical systems, and human respiratory safety. Tenant shall maintain Class-3 dust-filtration and electrostatic declumping systems at all primary personnel and cargo airlocks. Any damage to the building mechanical systems or HVAC ductwork caused by Tenant's failure to prevent regolith infiltration shall be repaired at Tenant's sole cost and expense.

dg:HazardousMaterialsCovenant.docset:Execution: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Commercial Pressurized Space Lease Agreement as of the Effective Date first written above.
